source: pages 1 to 3 of two-column.pdf (pdftotext -f 1 -l 3; page breaks checked per page) for the text; the generator eval/scorecard/fixtures/rotated_scan.sh leaves page 1 upright, turns page 2 by 90 degrees clockwise and page 3 by 270
notes: Three scanned pages, each turned differently, so a per-page orientation decision is required: page 1 reads as is, page 2 needs a 270 degree turn back, page 3 a 90 degree turn back.
Headings in source order: the title (level 0) and '1. West Egg' (level 1) on page 1, '1.1 The Buchanan House' (level 2) on page 3.

Anchors are the pdf-two-column anchors that fall on pages 1 to 3, in source order: ten on page 1, then the paragraphs of pages 2 and 3 in column order; a page read at the wrong orientation shows as a run of missing or out-of-order anchors.
The running header, the 'Page N' footers and the footnote on page 1 are furniture and appear in no anchor.
The byline anchor starts at 'Scott': the raster's small italic 'F.' loses its period to recognition jitter on some turns, and an anchor must not hinge on one glyph.
